svg.title: Say It For Me phone deployment architecture
svg.desc: Layered smartphone deployment architecture. Android app, audio APIs, model runtime, local storage, and compute hardware are planned. The Python reference layer is implemented only as a PC architecture and evaluation foundation.
svg.text: Say It For Me — smartphone deployment architecture
All phone layers are target or candidate states until an exact handset and compatible models are verified.

g.text: Explicit direction · push-to-talk · transcript · translation · FactorySafe warning / playback state

QAIRT / QNN where compatible · ONNX Runtime Mobile or CPU fallback
Model choice, precision, licensing, and latency remain evidence gates
CPU / GPU / NPU · RAM · local storage · integrated microphone · speaker / headset · battery · display
Exact phone, SoC, OS, capacity, power, thermal behavior, and device performance are not yet known
Typed contracts · mock pipeline · model-manifest controls · strict evaluator — not Android or real-model inference
